analyst_view.overall: Early view: Napoli host Lecce three days before Club Brugge visit in the Champions League. Allegri's side were tenth after a poor run, with tension around the club and Noa Lang at odds with the fans, though the president has backed Allegri. Lecce under Di Francesco are compact and physical away from home and have struggled in recent games.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals. Napoli's home games have averaged three goals and Lecce's away games about 2.9, but Napoli's attack had stalled before the break and Lecce defend deep. Those cancel out, so I stay with the number.

corners.text: The site expects 9.9 corners. I lean slightly higher: Napoli's home games have averaged almost 11 corners, and Allegri's side cross a lot when the build-up stalls. Lecce defending deep should give them plenty.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.0 cards. I lean slightly lower still: Napoli's games have averaged about 2.7 cards, and Lecce's games are also among the calmest in the league. Neither side's style produces many bookings.

shots.text: The site expects 28.4 shots. I lean slightly higher because Napoli's home games have averaged almost 32 shots, with opponents shooting freely too. Lecce allow almost 15 shots a game.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.7 shots on target. I lean slightly higher: Napoli's home games have averaged over nine on target, and Lecce's away games about ten. McTominay and De Bruyne were the players who got Napoli going after the break against Lazio.
